title: Front loading washing machines
visual_facts: A large white front loading washing machine fills the center of the image.
Its circular dark glass door is closed.
The machine has a control panel above the door with several buttons and a small display.
A QR code label is attached above the controls.
Part of another similar washing machine is visible on the right, marked W4.
A third machine is cropped along the left edge.
A wall fan and white tiled wall are visible above the machines.
spatial_relations: The W3 machine is between two adjacent machines.
The fan is above and left of W3.
uncertainties: Small labels and control markings are too small to read.
The image does not show a manufacturer or model name.
